title: Hold a tow truck operator's licence
what: Hold a tow truck operator's licence for the kind of towing work the business does.

sources.title: Tow Truck Industry Act 1998 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on business as a tow truck operator unless the person holds a tow truck operators licence that authorises the kind of towing work carried on by the person in the course of that business.
